name: startup-fixed-work-comparison
command:
set -e
node bench/fixed-work.mjs --reference build/startup-fixed-reference --candidate build/startup-fixed-current --tier light --slices 64 --output build/evidence/startup-fixed-light.json
node bench/fixed-work.mjs --reference build/startup-fixed-reference --candidate build/startup-fixed-current --tier raw --slices 64 --output build/evidence/startup-fixed-raw.json
node bench/fixed-work.mjs --reference build/startup-fixed-reference --candidate build/startup-fixed-current --tier raw --slices 16 --corpus docs/verification/optimization-v1/resume-exact.json --output build/evidence/startup-fixed-raw-shallow.json

limits.enforcement: transient user cgroup scope: MemoryMax, no swap; taskset; timeout; CPU rlimit; aggregate RSS backstop
